summary: Iteration 6 retest — CRITICAL BILLITEM FIX VERIFIED. Main agent added `tip_amount: float = 0` and `tip_via: Optional[Literal['cash','qr']] = None` to BillItem Pydantic model at /app/backend/server.py:135-136. Per-line tips now flow end-to-end. Iter-5 test suite: 8/8 PASS (previously 4/8). Full backend regression: 51 passed, 1 conditional skip (test_cannot_demote_last_admin_conditional — expected safeguard). Total 59/59 executed tests pass. Specifically verified: (a) POST /api/bills with items containing tip_amount=50 (qr) + tip_amount=50 (cash) → response has tip_amount=100, tip_qr_total=50, tip_cash_total=50, items preserve per-line tip_amount+tip_via, grand_total=1100=services_net(1000)+tip(100). (b) reports/summary today.tips ≥ 100 reflecting per-line tips. (c) cash-closing/summary returns numeric cash_sales excluding QR-tip portion. (d) PUT /api/bills/{bid} as admin preserves bill_no + created_at, updates services_net (1200*0.9=1080), tip_amount=100, tip_qr_total=100, grand_total=1180, adds edited_by_name + edited_at. Staff PUT → 403. Unknown id PUT → 404. Frontend not tested per request. No new issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: BillItem model now correctly declares tip_amount + tip_via, aligning with the aggregation logic at server.py:478-480 and 569-570. Model_dump() emits full item shape including tips.
Minor pytest warning: two class-scoped fixtures are declared as instance methods (deprecated in pytest 10). Non-blocking. Consider @classmethod when convenient.
